name: XFUND: Multilingual Visually Rich Form Understanding Benchmark
description: XFUND is a standardized human-annotated multilingual benchmark dataset for visually rich form understanding across 7 diverse languages: Chinese (ZH), Japanese (JA), Spanish (ES), French (FR), Italian (IT), German (DE), and Portuguese (PT). Developed by Microsoft Research Asia in conjunction with the LayoutXLM multimodal pre-training model, XFUND contains 1,393 authentic document forms. Each of the 7 languages comprises exactly 199 forms (149 training and 50 testing), annotated with word-level bounding boxes, transcription texts, key-value semantic entities (header, question, answer, other), and entity relation links for semantic entity recognition and relation extraction.

size.notes: ZIP archives per language in v1.0 release containing high-resolution JPG form scans and JSON annotation files with OCR and semantic relations.

citation.paper_title: XFUND: A Benchmark Dataset for Multilingual Visually Rich Form Understanding

provenance.collection_method: Synthetic collection and human verification of diverse real-world forms across 7 global non-English languages, labeled with fine-grained OCR bounding boxes and key-value entity pairs.
provenance.curation_notes: Extends the English-centric FUNSD benchmark methodology into a balanced 7-language multilingual evaluation suite. Samples count forms/pages rather than semantic word tokens.
data_sources: Multilingual business, government, and commercial forms
